verdict.rationale: Lighthouse has a public pricing page that commits to 'one flat price and no surprise fees', lays out a tiered menu of what is included (base vs Plus), and states up front that RFE work is included and government filing fees are excluded. However, no Lighthouse dollar figure appears anywhere in the evidence; the only amounts quoted are third-party USCIS and premium-processing fees. missing for 10: actual published Lighthouse fee amounts per visa type or tier, a priced service menu with dollar figures, independent confirmation that prices are visible without a sales call.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see real prices before I talk to anyone — published flat fees or a priced service menu on the provider's own site

citations.quote: every case comes with one flat price and no surprise fees.
Lighthouse does not charge additional fees for preparing responses to Requests for Evidence.
Not included: USCIS filing fees, typically around $1-3k and varying by company size, and Premium Processing fees, around $3K.
